  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Modify MappingPage overview
  |   |   |-- Replace the obsolete DiagramService ownership and pre-tldraw rendering path with the revision-store, controller, MappingEditorCanvas, and selection-canvas responsibilities.
  |   |   `-- Keep CanvasWorkspace, CanvasSession, controller checkpoints, and workspace persistence distinct; show MappingPage as their caller, not the owner of diagram revisions.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend MappingPage overview
  |   |   |-- Add MappingPage authoring/presentation composition: it opens PromptComposer and owns PromptComposerCoordinator drafts, pinned references, and run state; MappingEditorCanvas calls placement-level alternative controls and SidePanel rendering. Attach N4 here; a SidePanel is not a FloatingBox.
  |   |   |-- Add DiagramSearchService: MappingPage supplies current project and proposal documents, DiagramSearchPanel calls its worker, and MappingPage verifies revisions before match reveal. Attach N6 here.
  |   |   |-- Add workspace treemap tools: MappingPage owns panel visibility and canvas colors; CanvasTreemapContent reads mapped source, while ChangeTreemapContent reads change treemaps. Attach N7 here.
  |   |   |-- Add MappingPage.projectDiagrams: selection/highlight actions and agent commands call it; it owns creation of a retained child draft, projection history and layout state. ProjectionLayoutPanel calls the worker-backed layout update. Attach N8 here.
  |   |   `-- Show MappingPage calling CanvasViewControls/CanvasViewReceiver, the agent bridge, and persistence without moving their detailed ownership into this diagram.

  |   |   `-- Add SourceWindowPanel as a MappingPage-owned rendering caller: it reads retained display and focus state, preloads mapped files, renders SourceCodePane or SessionCodePanel in WindowPanel, and keeps window layout state separate from logical pane records.

  |   |   `-- Connect from the explicit MappingPage authoring/presentation composition component; detail PromptComposer, variant review, placement controls and SidePanel callers using prompt-composer and tldraw source files.

  |   |   `-- Connect from DiagramSearchService; detail indexing, panel queries, revision-checked reveal and mapped-source navigation using mapping/search and source-pane files.
  |   |-- [2] Add: Canvas and change treemaps (N7)
  |   |   `-- Connect from workspace treemap tools; detail source-range and change-hunk projections, shared presentation, colors and navigation using mapping/treemap and mapping/changes files.
  |   `-- [2] Add: Focused child-canvas projection (N8)
